A.name: Full pass
A.test: All 19 held-out cases pass all eight gates; every limit held; receipts published; the open verifier says PASS
A.what_it_proves: The factory wrote working code for a real legacy slice on its own, and outsiders can check it

B.name: Strong partial
B.test: 10–18 cases pass all eight gates; limits held; every failure has a judge receipt naming the difference
B.what_it_proves: The factory does most of it, and the judge catches what it gets wrong

C.name: Early partial
C.test: 1–9 cases pass; limits held; failures recorded
C.what_it_proves: The pipeline works end to end; the agents are the weak link, not the controls

D.name: Clean stop
D.test: Nothing passes, or the run stops itself on a limit or control, with a receipt saying why
D.what_it_proves: The controls work: it stops instead of shipping bad code

E.name: No run
E.test: The run never starts (freeze missed, no-go, blocker)

F.name: Unexplained
F.test: A limit exceeded, answers exposed, a case or gate changed after freeze, missing evidence, or the verifier disagrees
